location.title: Price based on your location
location.body: This price includes an adjustment that depends on the service address you gave us, such as a travel fee or a temporary surge rate for your area.

account.title: Price set for your account
account.body: This price comes from a price list or terms set up specifically for your account, contract or membership.

modeled.title: Price calculated from your equipment data
modeled.body: This price was calculated automatically using information about you and your equipment, including its repair history. Ask the business if you would like to know how it was set.
